fields.name: game work memory
fields.meaning: Everything below 0x5FD7 is live game memory (the game runs out of the save chip); the save is the framed copy at 0x6000
fields.evidence: code: all saved live variables sit at chip offsets below 0x5FD7; every play step changes them

fields.name: power-on work area
fields.meaning: Not save data: written on every power-on even with blank memory and never read back before being rewritten; most likely the top of the game stack
fields.evidence: diff of blank memory before/after first boot; boot read log (never read first)

fields.name: slot0 start marker
fields.meaning: Start marker of the first save copy, always 02; a copy without it is treated as empty
fields.evidence: code d000:542c writes, d000:5556 checks; save-to-save diff

fields.name: slot0 length
fields.meaning: Length of the saved data block that follows (always 0B1F = 2847 bytes)
fields.evidence: code d000:5437..544a writes CX=0xb1f from save_game d000:55d7; recomputed

fields.name: game tag
fields.meaning: Fixed game tag text "ﾓﾝﾓﾝﾃﾞｼﾞﾓﾝ V002" (half-width katakana + ASCII) copied from the ROM; loading rejects a copy whose tag does not match
fields.evidence: code d000:55d7 copies from ROM c250:0004, d000:5805 compares 16 bytes; ROM file offset 0x1c2504

fields.name: resume mode
fields.meaning: Where Continue resumes: 0 = on the field map (menu save), 1 = battle/arena path, 2 = special path
fields.evidence: code d000:7129 writes 0 before menu save, f000:df35 writes 1, d000:a465 writes 2; d000:5f00 dispatches on 0/1/other; natural save is 0

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Player funds
fields.evidence: code: 32-bit add/subtract across shop and battle code (d000:c5ed, f000:a7eb), clamped to 99,999,999 (0x05F5E0FF); zeroed at new game; 0 in saves

fields.name: battle points
fields.meaning: Points earned in battles, capped at 10000, reset to 0 when consumed
fields.evidence: code e000:c3d9 adds +1/+3 with cap 10000, e000:0e22 and d000:8df4 reset to 0; 13 in the natural save

fields.name: Digimon list
fields.meaning: 30 Digimon records of 0x48 bytes each (only the first is used in the natural save)
fields.evidence: code d000:55d7 copies 0x870 bytes from the live list; record_init f000:c4e9 builds records

fields.name: record: in use
fields.meaning: 1 = this record holds a Digimon, 0 = empty
fields.evidence: code f000:0ca9 tests ==1, f000:c4e9 sets 1; record 0 = 1, records 1-29 = 0

fields.name: record: species
fields.meaning: Species number of the Digimon (2 = Agumon, shown on the status screen)
fields.evidence: code f000:0ca9 indexes the species table with it; status screen shows Agumon for species 2

fields.name: record: ROM block
fields.meaning: 16 bytes copied from a per-gain ROM table (repeating value/FF pattern); probably the technique or move list
fields.evidence: code d000:8df4 copies 0x10 bytes from ROM pointers at c000:bfxx into record+2 on every gain

fields.name: record: stat bytes 0-2
fields.meaning: Three stat bytes from the species table (3, 0, 0); first may be level or MP-related
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 copies from species table entry +6..+8; value 3 matches displayed MP 3

fields.name: record: DP
fields.meaning: DP (health), 150 in the natural save
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 copies from species table; 150 matches status screen "DP 150/150"

fields.name: record: AP
fields.meaning: AP, 32 in the natural save
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 copies from species table; 32 matches status screen "AP 32/32"

fields.name: record: PP or SP
fields.meaning: One of PP/SP, value 7 (screen shows PP 7, SP 10; which offset is which is unresolved)
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 copies from species table; values match the status screen pair

fields.name: record: SP or PP
fields.meaning: The other of SP/PP, value 10
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 copies from species table; values match the status screen pair

fields.name: record: VP
fields.meaning: VP, 24 in the natural save
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 copies from species table; 24 matches status screen "VP 24/24"

fields.name: record: stat byte 6
fields.meaning: Stat byte from the species table (value 3, possibly MP current)
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 copies from species table entry +0x13; screen shows MP 3

fields.name: record: stat byte 7
fields.meaning: Stat byte from the species table (value 8)
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 copies from species table entry +0x14

fields.name: record: bytes 21-23
fields.meaning: Zeroed at creation, all zero in saves
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 zeroes; save dumps

fields.name: record: step counters
fields.meaning: Two counters that rise together while walking on the map (1, then 7, then 9 across three saves with walking between)
fields.evidence: diff between saves with walking between; live value rises step by step (1,4,6,7); start 0 at creation (f000:c4e9)

fields.name: record: bytes 26-46
fields.meaning: Zeroed at creation, all zero in saves
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 zeroes; save dumps

fields.name: record: rare flag
fields.meaning: Rare-variant flag: set to 1 when the creation roll comes up rare, else 0
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 sets 1 when d000:0413 returns 0 and flags live 0x43d0; 0 in saves

fields.name: record: event bytes
fields.meaning: Event/state bytes, zero as created; field code writes +0x30=2/+0x31..32=0x708 on one path
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 zeroes; f000:3d8a writes on event path; 0 in saves

fields.name: record: empty slots
fields.meaning: Ten FF/00 pairs as created; untouched in saves
fields.evidence: code f000:c4e9 fills; save dumps

fields.name: battle list
fields.meaning: 32-byte indexed table, 0xFF-cleared; managed together with the count byte that follows
fields.evidence: code: indexed reads/writes in battle and list code (e000:0e22, f000:055c/05f2/065e); 02 then FF fill in save

fields.name: battle list count
fields.meaning: Count/index into the 32-byte table (incremented/decremented, compared against 0x20)
fields.evidence: code f000:05f2/065e INC/DEC, f000:065e compares <0x20; 1 in save

fields.name: Digimon count
fields.meaning: Number of used records in the Digimon list (1)
fields.evidence: code f000:0ca9 loop bound; ++ on story gain (d000:8df4) and gift gain (d000:5805)

fields.name: unknown 0a30
fields.meaning: Unknown 3 bytes (FF FF FF), read by d000:ad37
fields.evidence: code d000:ad37 reads; save dump

fields.name: unknown 0a34
fields.meaning: Battle/state byte, read by battle code and cleared by menu code (0)
fields.evidence: code e000:b25b reads, f000:5283 clears

fields.name: unknown 0a2e
fields.meaning: Unknown byte (0); only saved, loaded and zeroed at new game
fields.evidence: code save/load only (d000:55d7/5805), cleared in f000:ce01

fields.name: event triggers
fields.meaning: 18 event trigger flags; a value of 1 starts the matching story event once
fields.evidence: code d000:8df4 tests trigger+done pairs (e.g. 0935==1 with 282c==0); new game sets all 0 then first = 1; save has first = 1

fields.name: Digimon capacity
fields.meaning: How many Digimon the player may hold; story events raise it (8 in the natural save)
fields.evidence: code: init 8 at new game (f000:ce01), +2/+3 in d000:8df4, +5 in d000:c5ed; gift path checks count < capacity

fields.name: species table
fields.meaning: One byte per species (113): 2 = owned, 1 = seen, 0 = unknown
fields.evidence: code f000:0ca9 and d000:63e3 set 2 from the Digimon list, e000:e760 sets 1; save has 2 at species 2 (Agumon) and 1 at species 3 and 50

fields.name: unknown 13b2
fields.meaning: 73-byte table written next to the species table (set to 2 where a species is registered); all zero
fields.evidence: code d000:63e3 writes 2, f000:8ded tests; save dump

fields.name: species counters
fields.meaning: Per-species counter, incremented with a cap of 100
fields.evidence: code d000:966b increments chapter-selected entries capped at 100, d000:63e3 sets 1 on first gain; all zero in saves

fields.name: stale block 0950
fields.meaning: 216 bytes copied into the save but never copied back on load; only used live by field code
fields.evidence: code: packed by d000:55d7 but no restore exists in d000:5805; used live in f000:3d8a; all zero

fields.name: unknown 0a36
fields.meaning: Unknown 11 bytes (zero); only saved, loaded and zeroed at new game
fields.evidence: code save/load only, cleared in f000:ce01

fields.name: map number
fields.meaning: Current map id (4 = the desk island in the natural save)
fields.evidence: code d000:8df4 assigns map ids per event (2,4,0xd,0xf,0x11), field code compares ==4; live value 4 at desk

fields.name: player X
fields.meaning: Player X position on the map (0x58 at the desk)
fields.evidence: live value moves 0x58 -> 0x28 when walking left; event/field code repositions it

fields.name: player Y
fields.meaning: Player Y position on the map (0x48 at the desk)
fields.evidence: code d000:8df4 adds 0x10 in an event move; field code reads/writes it with X

fields.name: order table
fields.meaning: 18-byte order table, identity 00..11 at new game, indexed by field code
fields.evidence: code f000:ce01 fills identity; indexed lookups in d000:6dc6/7129; unchanged in saves

fields.name: event flag 2858
fields.meaning: 0/1 event flag, set to 1 by story events
fields.evidence: code d000:8df4 sets/compares; 0 in save

fields.name: event done flags
fields.meaning: 12 flags set to 1 when a story event has been played
fields.evidence: code d000:8df4 sets (e.g. 282c=1) after each event; all 0 at new game; none done in save

fields.name: event flag 2958
fields.meaning: 0/1 flag (set in one routine, tested in two)
fields.evidence: code d000:afab sets 1, d000:8b21/afab test; 0 in save

fields.name: unknown 4388
fields.meaning: Unknown 20 bytes (5F E3 3A then FF and 00), entries compared against 0xFF
fields.evidence: code d000:9585 and f000:d754 compare ==0xff

fields.name: unknown 2a10
fields.meaning: Small counter (compared with 3, incremented in chapter code); 0 in save
fields.evidence: code d000:c5ed compares/INC

fields.name: story step
fields.meaning: Story progress id: 0x1e at new game, events advance it to 0x1f/0x20
fields.evidence: code f000:ce01 inits 0x1e, d000:8df4 writes 0x1f/0x20; 0x1e in save

fields.name: chapter
fields.meaning: Chapter/area id (field menu sets 1..7 and more; battle resume compares 4/6/9/12/13 with stage)
fields.evidence: code d000:7129 assigns, d000:5f00 compares pairs with stage; 0 in save

fields.name: stage
fields.meaning: Stage/round id paired with chapter
fields.evidence: code d000:5f00 compares chapter/stage pairs, battle code reads it, link code bumps it around a save; 0 in save

fields.name: unknown 0946
fields.meaning: Three unknown 16-bit values (zero)
fields.evidence: code: indexed reads in e000:b25b, writes in f000:e6c9

fields.name: unknown 133a
fields.meaning: Three unknown 16-bit values (zero), same accessor pair as 0946
fields.evidence: code: indexed reads in e000:b25b, writes in f000:e6c9

fields.name: unknown 4302
fields.meaning: Three counters, 0xFF at new game, decremented in list code
fields.evidence: code f000:ce01 fills FF, f000:8401 DEC; FF FF FF in save

fields.name: unknown 287e
fields.meaning: Two unknown 16-bit counters (incremented, thresholds 0x1170/0x117a)
fields.evidence: code d000:9a2b INC/CMP; zero in saves

fields.name: slot0 end marker
fields.meaning: End marker, always 03
fields.evidence: code d000:546c writes, d000:5574 checks

fields.name: slot0 checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT residue (start 0) over the length field, data and end marker (slot bytes 1..0xB22), byte-swapped, stored high byte first
fields.evidence: recomputed over every valid save image (see checksum notes); code d000:0580 with tables at d000:05c0/06c0

fields.name: slot0 padding
fields.meaning: Unused gap between copies (zero)
fields.evidence: code: copies are 0xB29 apart, the framed block is 0xB25 long

fields.name: slot1 (backup copy)
fields.meaning: Second identical copy with the same layout as the first; written right after the first on every save; read only when the first copy is missing, damaged or has the wrong tag
fields.evidence: code d000:55d7 calls the writer for copies 0 and 1; d000:5805 falls back to copy 1; both copies rewritten on every save

fields.name: gap after save
fields.meaning: Unused by the save (zero)
fields.evidence: save dumps

fields.name: gift tag
fields.meaning: 16-byte tag checked at load against the game tag; when it matches and there is room, the gift record below is appended to the Digimon list, the game saves itself, then this tag is cleared
fields.evidence: code d000:5805 compares with the ROM tag and clears; boot read log (read at load); zero in saves

fields.name: gift record
fields.meaning: 72-byte Digimon record appended to the list when the gift tag matches (same layout as a list record)
fields.evidence: code d000:5805 copies 0x48 bytes from 0x7810 to list[count], count++, then saves; zero in saves

fields.name: rest of chip
fields.meaning: Unused by the save (zero)
fields.evidence: save dumps
